label: preparing
what: Joint preparation of a lantern-decorated, bread-stocked gathering, plausibly the Day 1 18:00 great-hall civic hospitality appointment. Coordination is strongly supported by transfers, payment, matching lantern placement and repeated bread deliveries. Whether there was an undisclosed purpose is not established: the appointment record explicitly says the mayor approved the gathering, while committee names and detailed agenda remained unsupplied. Secretary knowingly assisted appointment logistics, but knowledge of any concealed preparation is not established; neighbour's involvement is also unproven. Confidence refers to the full claim of joint preparation not disclosed to the mayor, not to coordination alone.
